items.title: Nike claimed by Worldleaks ransomware group
items.summary: Nike was named as a victim by the Worldleaks ransomware group in a claim surfacing this month.

items.title: National Water Authority of Peru hit by Black Shrantac
items.summary: Peru's National Water Authority (ANA) was claimed as a target by the Black Shrantac ransomware group.

items.title: HandyTrac (Greystar, Litchfield Park AZ) claimed by Shadowbyt3$
items.summary: Access-control vendor HandyTrac, tied to Greystar's Litchfield Park, AZ operations, was discovered as a Shadowbyt3$ ransomware victim on September 15, 2026.

items.title: Better Accounting Solutions listed as ransomware victim
items.summary: Better Accounting Solutions was discovered as a ransomware leak-site victim around September 14, 2026.

items.title: Bernath & Rosenberg listed as ransomware victim
items.summary: Law firm Bernath & Rosenberg was discovered as a ransomware leak-site victim around September 14, 2026.

items.title: Veradigm claimed by The Gentlemen, 3.5M patient records alleged
items.summary: The Gentlemen ransomware group listed healthcare IT vendor Veradigm on its leak site around September 4-5, 2026, claiming roughly 3.5 million patient records with an estimated intrusion date of September 4.

ransomware.note: Named-victim detail was limited to leak-site listings this cycle; per-incident write-ups had not yet been published for the newer claims.

items.title: Azure East US outage disrupts ChatGPT, Claude, and Grok
items.summary: An Azure East US outage on September 3, 2026 caused roughly 90 minutes of simultaneous disruption to ChatGPT, Claude, and Grok during UK business hours, underscoring shared hyperscaler dependency risk.

outage.note: No additional distinct outage events dated to September 2026 surfaced this cycle; trackers note a broader 2026 pattern of multi-day AWS/Google Cloud/Cloudflare incidents, with Forrester projecting further major hyperscaler outages this year.

items.title: CISA adds Cisco Secure FMC auth-bypass to KEV (CVE-2026-20079, CVSS 10.0)
items.summary: CISA added an unauthenticated authentication-bypass flaw in Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center to its KEV catalog, giving federal agencies until September 12, 2026 to patch.

items.title: CISA adds Citrix NetScaler auth-bypass to KEV (CVE-2026-19490, CVSS 9.3)
items.summary: An authentication-bypass vulnerability in Citrix NetScaler ADC and Gateway was added to CISA's KEV catalog alongside the Cisco and Fortinet flaws, with the same September 12, 2026 federal patch deadline.

items.title: CISA sets September 16 deadline for Starlette and LiteLLM flaws
items.summary: Federal agencies have until September 16, 2026 to remediate newly KEV-listed flaws in the Starlette ASGI framework and LiteLLM.

items.title: PivotC2 RAT campaign exploits CVE-2025-25249
items.summary: A campaign weaponizing CVE-2025-25249 delivered a Node.js remote access trojan dubbed PivotC2, targeting roughly 3,000 IP addresses and infecting 178 devices.

items.title: M 6.5 earthquake, 126 km NNE of Teluknaga, Indonesia
items.summary: A magnitude 6.5 earthquake struck near Teluknaga, Indonesia on September 11, 2026; no tsunami warning was issued.

items.title: Typhoon Noul prompts 20,000 evacuations in Guangdong, China
items.summary: Over 20,000 people were evacuated in Guangdong as Typhoon Noul approached, with forecasters warning of up to 600mm (24in) of rain.

physical.note: France/Spain wildfire activity and Typhoon Sinlaku reported earlier in the 2026 season could not be confirmed as September events and were excluded.
